# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.94

This release gives Buddy Rush clubs authoritative procedural-world lots,
corrects the roadside transit layout, and adds moving double-decker buses.

## Club and world placement

- Uses the shared one-unit world occupancy grid to reserve every rival
  clubhouse and Buddy Bus Stop lot before procedural objects are snapped and
  placed.
- Adds deterministic clearance around each club so nearby generated buildings,
  trees, lamps, and phone boxes cannot crowd or visually swallow it.
- Rejects complete procedural assemblies together, preventing orphan roofs,
  windows, doors, tree tops, or lamp lights around reserved sites.
- Increments the procedural generator version so existing saves immediately
  rebuild affected chunks with the corrected layout.

## Buddy Bus transit

- Rotates the Buddy Bus shelter so its open side faces the adjacent road.
- Adds tall red and blue double-decker buses to the live traffic system on the
  road serving the stop.
- Gives buses their own full-size collision boxes, pedestrian look-ahead,
  following distance, route speed, windows, doors, wheels, and two-deck body.
- Keeps buses as public traffic rather than offering the traffic-car takeover
  action.

## Regression coverage

- Added multi-seed checks proving procedural buildings and props remain outside
  every Buddy Rush grid reservation.
- Added checks for club clearance and road-facing bus-stop orientation.
- Added traffic tests for both coloured buses, their route, size, safety
  envelope, and collision dimensions.
- Re-ran the four-location mobile Buddy Rush visual scenario and inspected the
  corrected club and transit layouts.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.
